sentences.text: the I Additional District Judge, Kalaburagi (for short 'Appellate Court'), wherein compensation of Rs.2,52,460/- per acre for dry land was awarded and modifying the judgment and award dated 18.12.2014 passed in LAC Nos.57/2010, 59/2010 and 53/2010 by the Senior Civil Judge Aland (for short 'Reference Court'), the appellants are seeking for further enhancement.

2. Heard Sri Harshavardhan R. Patil, learned counsel appearing for the appellants-claimants, Smt.
Archana P. Tiwari, learned Additional Advocate General along with Sri F. M. Inamdar, High Court Government Pleader for the respondents.

Learned counsel on both sides submit that the decision of the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the case of Khandoba s/o Bhimarao and another Vs. Chief Engineer IP, IP Zone1(Khandoba) is applicable as an exempla to the present facts.

entities.text: Khandoba s/o Bhimarao and another Vs. Chief Engineer IP, IP Zone1(Khandoba)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. The claimants-appellants are the owners of land Sy.No.56/6, 55/3 and 110/1-4 of Donnur village,
Taluka Aland, District Kalaburagi, which was acquired by the respondent under 4(1) notification dated 10.08.2006 for the purpose of construction of Minor Irrigation Tank.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation of Rs.31,000/- per acre for dry land.

On reference by the claimants, the reference Court awarded compensation of Rs.1,75,000/- per acre and in the appeal preferred by the claimants, the Appellate Court awarded compensation of Rs.2,52,460/- per acre for the dry land.

The Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Khandoba's case, by placing reliance on the judgment in LAC No.263/2003 passed by the Reference Court and the judgment in LACA No.156/2010 which have attained finality and the award has been satisfied, awarded compensation of Rs.2,31,000/- per acre for dry land by taking escalation at 10% per annum for the last four years.

6. In the instant case, similar lands have been acquired for similar purposes and the land acquired is under notification dated 10.08.2006 by adding escalation at 10% per annum for a period of three years with cumulative effect
, the compensation that works out is Rs.3,07,461/- per acre for dry land.

Accordingly, this Court pass the following:
ORDER I.
The Miscellaneous Second Appeals are allowed in part with costs.

The claimants are entitled for compensation of Rs.3,07,461/- per acre for dry land with cumulative effect as against Rs.2,52,460/-
per acre for dry land.
III. The deficit Court fee, if any, to be paid by the appellants within a period of eight weeks.
